scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索): 用户在社区平台搜索帖子、问答、评论等 UGC 内容。 核心指标是搜索相关性 (nDCG) 和点击率 (CTR)。 关注：语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回、排序模型、LLM 在搜索中的应用。

papers.title: DoubtLess: Training-Free Contrastive Decoding for Efficient Reasoning
papers.abstract: Reasoning models achieve strong performance through long chains of thought (CoT), but often spend more tokens than needed to solve a problem. Existing ways to shorten the CoT require additional training for each model, add a fixed steering vector to the model's hidden states, or use decoding heuristics such as stopping early or banning words like "wait", which can reduce accuracy. We propose DoubtLess, a training-free decoding method in which a much smaller reasoning model steers the large one towards brevity. The small model reads the large model's CoT so far twice, once prompted to be brief (the brief thinker) and once prompted to be verbose (the verbose thinker), and the difference between its two logit vectors, scaled by a strength, is added to the large model's logits at every step of the CoT. On seven benchmarks of competition mathematics, graduate-level science and competitive programming, DoubtLess shortens the CoT of Qwen3-32B by 31% with unchanged accuracy, outperforming five
papers.summary: 针对推理模型反复检查导致输出过长的问题，DoubtLess 用小模型分别生成简短与冗长两种条件下的 logits，再用二者差值引导大模型解码，无需重新训练。在七个数学、科学和编程基准上，Qwen3-32B 的思维链缩短 31% 且准确率不变，自调试编程代理每轮思考 token 减少 20%。
papers.key_insight: 核心设计是把简洁性控制放到解码阶段，并由小模型随上下文动态提供方向。社区 UGC 搜索中的查询分析或复杂问答可先离线测试该方案，重点核查长尾问题准确率、端到端延迟和额外小模型开销；论文的 token 节省不能直接等同于线上成本同比下降。

papers.title: FlashVSR+: Efficient Video Super-Resolution via Hybrid Attention and Reward-Yield Distribution Matching
papers.authors: Ruchang Yao, Shi Guo, Junhao Zhuang, Mingde Yao, Xin Cai
papers.abstract: Recent video super-resolution (VSR) models achieve efficient one-step generation through diffusion distillation. However, high-resolution inference remains costly, and distilled models are difficult to align with human preferences. These challenges call for improvements in both model architecture and training strategy. We present FlashVSR+ to address both limitations. On the architecture side, we introduce hybrid attention based on the strong locality observed in pretrained VSR models, while retaining sparse global interaction for long-range consistency. It achieves up to 2times DiT speedup and 45\% lower peak memory, enabling spatially untiled 4K VSR on a single 24GB RTX 4090. On the training side, we propose Reward-Yield Distribution Matching Distillation (Ry-DMD) for preference-aligned one-step generation. Ry-DMD uses reward-weighted teacher rollouts to incorporate black-box rewards into distribution matching, without backpropagating through the reward model. We further show that Ry
papers.summary: FlashVSR+ 针对高分辨率视频超分的推理与偏好对齐成本，结合局部为主的混合注意力和奖励加权分布匹配蒸馏。论文报告 DiT 最高加速 2 倍、峰值显存降低 45%，可在单张 24GB RTX 4090 上执行无需空间切块的 4K 超分，并发布代码、模型和训练数据。
papers.key_insight: 可借鉴之处是先利用注意力局部性降低推理开销，再通过稀疏全局交互维持一致性；奖励模型不必可微。该工作适合社区视频内容处理或多模态素材生产，不能直接解释为短文本检索 nDCG 或 CTR 提升，落地应单独评估画质、时延及 GPU 占用。

papers.title: RadixArk Joins Forces with Google to Bring Full SGLang Features to TPUs
papers.abstract: RadixArk Joins Forces with Google to Bring Full SGLang Features to TPUs
papers.summary: RadixArk 与 Google 合作扩展 SGLang 的 TPU 推理支持，已提供 SGL-JAX，并规划补充面向 PyTorch 的 SGL-torchtpu。文章披露生态规模超过 3 万 GitHub 星标、1700 名贡献者，但没有提供 TPU 吞吐或成本对比实验；这些数字反映生态成熟度，不构成性能优势证据。
papers.key_insight: 对社区搜索平台而言，统一服务接口有助于探索 GPU 与 TPU 的资源选择，但硬件切换仍需验证算子、量化、缓存及模型兼容性。文章中的 PyTorch 原生后端属于后续计划，不能视作已交付；建议先用已有 SGL-JAX 做小规模基准，再按实际负载判断迁移价值。
